inspiration: Sequence selectors on one line: stopping (default), cycle, shuffle, once (src/compiler/Parser/ParsedHierarchy/Sequence/SequenceType.ts lines 1-6). Keep the four modes; use cycle and shuffle for idle barks and once for first-time lines.
Tags on a line as a side channel that does not change the printed text (src/engine/Tag.ts line 5). Keep tags as cue carriers for sound and emote cues on the fight bus; use our own cue names.
Seedable PRNG because the platform has none (src/engine/PRNG.ts lines 2-7). Keep one seed that reproduces a sequence; store the seed in the fight record for replay (row 19).
Budgeted step: the story runs for a millisecond budget and resumes on the next call (src/engine/Story.ts lines 349-355). Use the same shape as a per-tick NPC budget (row 18 sub-line).
Unbudgeted counterpart ContinueMaximally (src/engine/Story.ts line 607; body not read). Keep both modes: budgeted for live play, unbudgeted for tests.
Save and load files exist in src/engine (StoryState.ts, JsonSerialisation.ts, StatePatch.ts, VariablesState.ts; names only). Check before reuse for row 19 snapshot shape.
Single JSON bundle of all project files for browser compiles (docs/compiler-differences.md line 7). Relevant to a catalogue bundle, not to art.
